item.title: Iran expels Swedish diplomat in retaliatory move
item.description: Tehran gives Swedish official 48 hours to leave as Iran says Stockholm is bowing down to outside pressure.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump weighs ‘big decision’ on Iran, tanker hit in Hormuz
item.description: Trump says he faces a 'big decision' on whether to 'annihilate' his Iranian foes, adding that 'anything could happen'.

item.title: Migrant crossings to Europe by sea drop sharply amid heightened risks: IOM
item.description: More than 2,200 migrants died or vanished at sea in 2026, despite declining crossings into Europe, says IOM.

item.title: US approves $414M uranium investment in Niger, two years after troops left
item.description: Uranium project investment could mark a turning point in US-Niger and US-Canada relations.

item.title: Russia election: Could other parties challenge United Russia?
item.description: Russians vote for the first time since 2022. Can opposition parties challenge Putin-backed United Russia in this vote?

item.title: Trinidad and Tobago ends state of emergency amid pushback over mass arrests
item.description: Lawyers criticised mass arrests under emergency powers that allowed authorities to detain people without charge.

item.title: US judge orders 30-day notice prior to any Kennedy Center physical changes
item.description: The ruling comes amid legal battle over Trump’s changes to the Kennedy Center, including his effort to rename it.

item.title: Trump administration approves sale of F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia
item.description: The deal, which needs approval from Congress, comes as Riyadh seeks Washington's help in its war with Yemen's Houthis.

item.title: Yemenis recount journey to Djibouti as refugee arrivals surge
item.description: Djibouti has appealed to the international community to help provide humanitarian assistance as thousand flee Yemen.

item.title: US approves visas for top Iranian leaders to attend UN General Assembly
item.description: Iran's delegation to UNGA will be smaller this year, with travel restrictions and limits on luxury goods purchases.

item.title: Pennsylvania seeks CDC help amid dispute over US measles deaths
item.description: The CDC and officials from the US state differ over how four deaths should be classified as cases continue to spread.

item.title: Russia, China veto UN mandate to monitor Iran sanctions
item.description: Move ends the Security Council’s watchdog panel on Iran sanctions.

item.title: At least 26 killed in clashes along Sudan-South Sudan border region
item.description: UN Interim Security Force for Abyei strengthens security on the ground after days of deadly fighting.

item.title: Why does Brazil get to speak first at UNGA?
item.description: Why does Brazil get to speak first at UNGA?

item.title: Can ‘middle powers’ come together to build a new economic alliance?
item.description: Canada's prime minister outlines plans for stronger ties with the EU.

item.title: Why have China’s oil prices reached a record high?
item.description: Why have China's oil prices reached a record high?

item.title: Russia’s plans may include strikes against Ukraine’s allies, Poland says
item.description: Warsaw also says it scrambled military planes in response to a Russian attack in western Ukraine, close to its border.

item.title: Ilhan Omar attacker sentenced to more than a year in prison
item.description: The assailant sprayed vinegar at Ilhan Omar, admitting political motives were behind the assault at a townhall.

item.title: Four bodies found in Nepal tunnel as flood search continues
item.description: Rescuers in Nepal have recovered four bodies from a flooded hydropower tunnel in Chilime.

item.title: Houthi leader denies targeting Mecca, vows to protect holy city
item.description: Houthi leader Abdul Malik al-Houthi pledges to defend Mecca and other Islamic holy sites.

item.title: Russia ‘sabotaging’ power supply lines at Zaporizhzhia plant: Greenpeace
item.description: Investigation finds no evidence of Russia's claims that Ukrainian attacks hit the nuclear power plant.

item.title: Third person dies from malaria in cluster near Germany’s Frankfurt Airport
item.description: Frankfurt grapples with a rare malaria outbreak tied to air travel, marking three deaths in recent months.

item.title: Serbia opens factory to assemble Israeli-made drones
item.description: Critics say Serbia's military ties with Israel are rising significantly.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Israelis protest outside ‘NAZA’ filmmaker’s home
item.description: Dozens of Israelis protested outside 'NAZA' filmmaker’s family home, chanting 'death to traitors'

item.title: US secures release of detained citizen Adam Castillo in Myanmar
item.description: Businessman Adam Castillo had been detained by authorities for three months on breach of trust allegations.
